stories.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
stories.simple_summary: A credit rating company is thinking about downgrading Nvidia's financial rating because of concerns about the company's leadership and decision-making structure.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and people who own Nvidia stock. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
stories.simple_summary: Google tried to patent a system that would create fake AI videos and ads personalized just for you based on everything the company knows about you. The patent was rejected, but Google might try again.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters for anyone who watches videos online. If this ever gets approved and used, you could see more ads and videos designed to keep you watching longer.

stories.title: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
stories.simple_summary: OpenAI is combining its ChatGPT service into one system and may limit how much heavy users can access it.
stories.why_it_matters: If you pay for ChatGPT and use it a lot, you might hit your usage limit faster after this change.

stories.title: Jensen Huang broke Nvidia’s code of conduct, and his employees may not forget it
stories.simple_summary: The CEO of Nvidia broke the company's own rules of conduct that apply to everyone else.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to Nvidia employees who may feel upset that the leader doesn't follow the same rules. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: SpaceX gets green light to deploy 1 million satellites for data centers in space
stories.simple_summary: SpaceX got permission to launch up to 1 million satellites into space to use as data centers.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to investors and technology companies. It could eventually lead to faster internet, but that's years away.

stories.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei calls accusations of surrendering human control to AI ‘absurd’
stories.simple_summary: The leader of Anthropic (a company that makes AI) says the accusations that he wants machines to make their own decisions without humans is false and ridiculous.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors and AI industry experts. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Want to buy your kid an AI toy this Christmas? Not in New York
stories.simple_summary: New York banned AI toys that chat with kids for five years because they found safety problems, like kids seeing inappropriate content and possible harm to their feelings.
stories.why_it_matters: If you live in New York and want to buy your grandchild or child a chatbot toy, you cannot do that now.

stories.title: FCC signs off on SpaceX’s plan to put up to 1 million data center satellites into space
stories.simple_summary: The government approved SpaceX's plan to put up to 1 million satellites with AI chips in space to run like computer centers in the sky.
stories.why_it_matters: This is mostly important to investors and big technology companies. There's nothing you need to do right now.

stories.title: Character.AI’s plan to auction off users’ private chats challenged by state AGs
stories.simple_summary: Character.AI, a company in financial trouble, was planning to sell its users' private conversations as part of going out of business. State officials say this violates privacy, especially because over 2 million children had accounts there.
stories.why_it_matters: If you or your family used Character.AI, your private conversations might be at risk. This shows why you should be careful about what personal things you share with AI chatbots.

stories.title: Miss Universe 2026 Faces Backlash for Response to AI Question
stories.simple_summary: The person chosen to be Miss Universe in 2026 gave an answer about AI that upset some people.
stories.why_it_matters: This is celebrity news. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: This May Be the Best Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock to Buy in December (Hint: It’s Not Micron or Oracle)
stories.simple_summary: An article recommends a particular company's stock as a good investment in AI.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors. There's nothing you need to do.

stories.title: Nothing offers a full look at its AI earbuds and charging case
stories.simple_summary: A company called Nothing is releasing wireless earbuds that can record phone calls and turn them into written text summaries.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use wireless earbuds and want one that can record and summarize your conversations, this is a new option to consider.
